title: Introduction to Information Science: Needs, Sources and Organisation

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Intellectual property?
o: the practice of keeping each name or subject in one consistent form
a society in which creating and using information is the main source of wealth
the limited copying allowed for study, research or criticism without permission
the legal rights that protect creations of the mind from unauthorised use
items.s: Intellectual property: the legal rights that protect creations of the mind from unauthorised use. The other options describe Information society, Fair dealing, Authority control.

items.s: Intellectual property: the legal rights that protect creations of the mind from unauthorised use. The other options describe Visceral need, Latent need, Thesaurus.

items.q: The statement “an economy in which information work and services outweigh material production” describes which of the following?
